backup.description: The backup sync system follows the AI Unix Philosophy. It is composed of a series of small, modular Python scripts orchestrated by the Gemini CLI.

workflow.description: Lists all local files in the repository that are candidates for backup.
workflow.gemini_interaction: Presents the list of files to the user and asks for confirmation to proceed.

workflow.description: Compares the list of local files with the remote backup on Google Drive to identify new or modified files.
workflow.gemini_interaction: Presents the list of new or modified files to the user and asks for confirmation to upload.

workflow.description: Uploads the new or modified files to the Google Drive backup folder.
workflow.gemini_interaction: Confirms that the upload is complete and reports any errors.

inbox.description: The inbox sync system follows the AI Unix Philosophy. It is composed of a series of small, modular Python scripts orchestrated by the Gemini CLI.

workflow.description: Lists all files in the user's Google Drive inbox folder.
workflow.gemini_interaction: Presents the list of files to the user and asks for confirmation to download.

workflow.description: Downloads the selected files from the Google Drive inbox folder to the local `inbox/` directory.
workflow.gemini_interaction: Confirms that the download is complete and reports any errors.

workflow.description: Processes the downloaded files. For example, it might convert Google Docs to Markdown.
workflow.gemini_interaction: Asks the user for instructions on how to process each file.

shared.description: The shared sync system follows the AI Unix Philosophy. It is composed of a series of small, modular Python scripts orchestrated by the Gemini CLI.

workflow.description: Lists all files in the shared Google Drive folder.
workflow.gemini_interaction: Presents the list of files to the user and asks for confirmation to download.

workflow.description: Compares the list of remote files with the local `shared/` directory to identify new or modified files.
workflow.gemini_interaction: Presents the list of new or modified files to the user and asks for confirmation to download.

workflow.description: Downloads the new or modified files from the shared Google Drive folder to the local `shared/` directory.
workflow.gemini_interaction: Confirms that the download is complete and reports any errors.
